top_signals.title: Energy Reliability Is Becoming More Important Than Energy Politics
top_signals.summary: For much of the past decade, energy debates often pitted fossil fuels against clean energy. Governments announced dates for phasing out technologies, investors tried to anticipate which industries would lose favor, and energy policy increasingly became entangled with political identity.  The war with Iran has exposed the limitations of approaching energy policy that way. When supplies are disrupted and prices rise sharply, governments become much less interested in ideological consistency and much more interested in keeping fuel available,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hoax bomb threats repeatedly disrupt flights across Europe this week. Here’s what we know
top_signals.summary: Dozens of flights across Europe reported bomb threats this week, disrupting air travel across London, Dublin, and Helsinki.

top_signals.summary: Trump revealed the shake-up three days after Democrats' landslide victory in the midterm elections, winning majority control of the House and Senate.

top_signals.title: Certificate authority DigiCert reports data breach involving business customer info
top_signals.summary: DigiCert explained that over the summer, an internal business system was "externally accessible when that was not intended," and someone had created an unauthorized account.
